content.title: World Baseball Classic Highlights: Venezuela Beats USA in Final
content.text: Mar 17, 2026 - 5:02p ET Final Score: Venezuela 3, USA 2 Live Coverage for this has ended Mar 17, 2026 - 10:28p ET Bryce Harper's 2-Run Home Run Ties the Game Bryce Harper hit a shot to straightaway center, scoring Bobby Witt Jr., and tying the World Baseball Classic Final at two. It looked desolate for USA, but one swing from Harper changed everything. The Phillies slugger now has two of the three hits for Team USA.Mar 17, 2026 - 9:54p ET Team USA Scoreless Through 6 Innings Aaron Judge represented the go-ahead run at the plate with Bryce Harper on first. But Judge grounded out to third base, ending the sixth inning, ensuring Team USA remained scoreless. Moreso, Team USA has mustered just two hits.Mar 17, 2026 - 9:24p ET Wilyer Abreu's Home Run Extends Venezuela's Lead Wilyer Abreu added to Venezuela's advantage with a leadoff home run to start the fifth inning. One batter later, Team USA went to its bullpen, pulling starter Nolan McLean after 4.2 innings. Mar 17, 2026 - 8:55p ET Royals Teammates Salvador Perez, Maikel Garcia Combine for Venezuela's 1st Run Salvador Perez singled into right field to become Venezuela's third base-runner of the game. He came around to score after Nolan McLean issued a walk to Ronald Acuna Jr., threw wild pitch and conceded a sacrifice fly to Maikel Garcia. Garcia's RBI gave Venezuela a 1-0 lead in the third inning. Mar 17, 2026 - 8:47p ET Eduardo Rodriguez, Nolan McLean Each With 2 Strikeouts Through 2 Innings It's a pitcher's duel early on in the World Baseball Classic Final in Miami. Despite conceding a hit in each of the first two innings, Team USA starter locked in, getting Eugenio Suarez and Gleyber Torres to strike out on consecutive at-bats with off-speed pitches. Eduardo Rodriguez matched McLean's total, striking out Aaron Judge to end the first inning and Kyle Schwarber to start the second. Mar 17, 2026 - 5:01p ET Team USA Gold Medal Inspiration It never hurts to wear the jersey of a gold-medal team ahead of the championship game. Yankees superstar Aaron Judge prepping the Team USA hockey jersey as he arrives at the stadium in Miami. Team USA had a clean sweep on the hockey podium – men's, women's, and Paralympic – at the Winter Games in Milan/Cortina. Mar 17, 2026 - 5:01p ET USA Starting Lineup: McLean on Mound; Judge Hitting Third USA manager Mark DeRosa will go with New York Mets starter Nolan McLean for Tuesday's final. He started in the USA's lone loss at the WBC, a 8-6 setback to Italy in Pool B play. The 24-year-old McLean had a 2.06 ERA in 48 innings for the Mets down the stretch last season."I’m built for this," McLean said. "I’ve been waiting my whole life for something like this."The vaunted USA lineup has nine home runs through the tournament, with four players (Yankees OF Aaron Judge, Red Sox OF Roman Anthony, Cubs OF Pete Crow-Armstrong, and Orioles 2B Gunnar Henderson) with two each. Anthony leads the team with seven RBI and Phillies slugger Kyle Schwarber has eight hits so far. Live Coverage for this began on Mar 17, 2026 - 11:17p ET
